description:
Safe to remove if you're not using VoWifi.
You need to know that:
3GPP is a standards organization for mobile telephony (2G/3G/4G/5G).
Non-3GPP RAT refers to wireless connection methods not specified by 3GPP, including Wi-Fi.
ePDG (evolved Packet Data Gateway) secures connections over untrusted non-3GPP access, commonly used for VoWiFi (Voice over Wi-Fi). For more information:
- https://www.3gpp.org/technologies/keywords-acronyms/100-the-evolved-packet-core
- https://www.aptilo.com/solutions/mobile-data-offloading/3gpp-wifi-access/
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/System_Architecture_Evolution#Evolved_Packet_Core_(EPC)
